'''Bianco''' is a Non-Player Character (NPC) in the game. It is the rabbit that appears alongside {{c|Carrol}}.

==Debut Appearance==
As an NPC character, Bianco first appears in the Festive Event, [[A Colorful Hunt]].

==History==
In A Colorful Hunt, Bianco ventures off with Carrol to find out about a peculiar odd creature known as {{c|Cotton}}. It is seen aiding Carrol in the battles she is involved in, mainly against Cotton.

==Personality==
Bianco is a helpful companion of Carrol's, obeying her orders very well. Bianco tends to have poor food manners, as it was seen scolded by Carrol when fighting Cotton.

==Trivia==
*Despite appearing in A Colorful Hunt, Bianco does not have any NPC artwork.
*Bianco is not known to talk in any form of dialogue, despite being mentioned throughout A Colorful Hunt.
*Bianco appears in every evolution form of Carrol.
